wake.title: Wake up the scale
wake.description: Step briefly on the {name} scale so its display lights up, then submit. Home Assistant will pair with it. If the scale shows a code, you will be asked for it.

passkey.title: Pairing code
passkey.description: Type the code shown on the scale display.

connect_failed.title: Connection failed
connect_failed.description:
Could not connect or pair: {error}

Wake the scale up (step on it briefly) and submit to retry.

select_user.title: User
select_user.description: Pick your user on the scale, or create a new one (8 users max).

pin.title: User PIN
pin.description: The scale now shows a 4-digit PIN for this user. Type it here.

new_user.title: New user
new_user.description: The scale needs these values to compute body composition. {error}

data.initials: Initials (3 letters, shown on the scale)

data_description.activity_level: 1 = little or no activity, 2 = light effort (walking, gardening), 3 = moderate effort 2 to 4 times a week, 4 = intense effort 4 to 6 times a week, 5 = intensive training or hard physical work, at least 1 h a day

progress.connect: Connecting to the scale and pairing...
progress.measure: Step on the scale now, barefoot, for a first measurement. It teaches the scale to recognize you.

error.invalid_passkey: The code is made of 6 digits at most.
error.cannot_connect: Lost the connection to the scale. Wake it up and retry.
error.register_failed: The scale refused the new user.

abort.no_devices_found: No SBF73 scale found. Step on it briefly to wake it up and retry.
